verdict.rationale: Unleash documents its own multi-item mechanisms. Change requests can group several changes and apply them together at a set time, and export/import moves feature flags in bulk for migration. Segments, defined once and reused across any number of flags, act as an indirect lever; the Admin API alone is only a building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: explicit bulk-edit, bulk-toggle or bulk-archive operations across many flags, documentation of batch API or MCP endpoints, and hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Change requests also allow you to group changes and apply them at a specific point in time.
Export/import feature flags for easy migration
Instead of repeating the same rules in multiple places, you can define a segment once and reuse it across any number of feature flags
